hints.rateType.type: ASK | BID | MIDPOINT | HIGH_ASK | HIGH_BID | LOW_ASK | LOW_BID | FROM_EVENT

assumptions.reason: Stop processing when no exchange rate is found to avoid incorrect billing.

blockers.message: CURRENCY_LOOKUP fromCurrency.type is required. Is the source currency STATIC (fixed code) or FROM_EVENT (read from an event field)?
CURRENCY_LOOKUP fromCurrency.currency is required when type is STATIC. What is the source currency code? (e.g. 'EUR')
CURRENCY_LOOKUP fromCurrency.field is required when type is FROM_EVENT. Which event field contains the source currency code?
CURRENCY_LOOKUP toCurrency.type is required. Is the target currency STATIC (fixed code) or FROM_EVENT (read from an event field)?
CURRENCY_LOOKUP toCurrency.currency is required when type is STATIC. What is the target currency code? (e.g. 'USD')
CURRENCY_LOOKUP toCurrency.field is required when type is FROM_EVENT. Which event field contains the target currency code?
CURRENCY_LOOKUP rateType.type is required. Which exchange rate type? (ASK, BID, MIDPOINT, HIGH_ASK, HIGH_BID, LOW_ASK, LOW_BID, or FROM_EVENT)
CURRENCY_LOOKUP rateType.field is required when rateType is FROM_EVENT. Which event field contains the exchange rate?
CURRENCY_LOOKUP dateField.field is required. Which event field contains the date used to look up the exchange rate?
CURRENCY_LOOKUP rateField is required. What output field name should the looked-up exchange rate be written to? (e.g. 'exchangeRate')
